webgl.title: WebGL context lost or blocked
webgl.desc: The browser's WebGL rendering context was lost or blocked (context loss). This usually happens with too many 3D/map tabs open or tight GPU resources.
webgl.s1: Close other 3D / map tabs using GPU memory
webgl.s2: Make sure "hardware acceleration" is enabled in browser settings
webgl.s3: Retry with the button below or reload the page
webgl.canvasAria: Map canvas (arrow keys pan, plus/minus zoom)
